title: Open Targets multi-ancestry fine-mapping pipeline parameters
description: Parameters for the Open Targets multi-ancestry fine-mapping Nextflow pipeline.

manifest.description: Tab-separated manifest describing studies and summary-statistics inputs.

manifest_base_dir.description: Base directory used to resolve relative manifest paths.

output_dir.description: Directory where pipeline outputs and reports are written.

locus_breaker_method.description: Implementation used for ancestry-specific locus breaking.

canonical_region_min_maf.description: Strict minimum MAF for canonical-region variants, calculated as min(EAF, 1-EAF).

canonical_region_max_region_span_bp.description: Inclusive maximum span of a merged canonical region in base pairs.

ld_annotation_method.description: Backend used for ancestry-specific LD annotation.

hailing_ducks_container.description: Container image used by Hailing Ducks LD annotation.

hailing_ducks_max_cached_blocks.description: Maximum Hailing Ducks LD blocks cached per task.

collector_container.description: Collector image used by cloud profiles.

gentropy_spark_conf.description: JSON Spark configuration passed to Gentropy.

gentropy_ld_annotation_spark_conf.description: Optional Spark configuration for Gentropy LD annotation.

empty_status_stub_emit.description: Emit empty-status records during stub execution.

ld_pair_stats_stub_emit.description: Emit LD-pair status records during stub execution.

ld_pair_stats_stub_empty_locus_set_ids.description: Locus-set IDs receiving empty-LD status in stub tests.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix for trace, report, timeline, and DAG filenames.

validate_params.description: Validate pipeline parameters against this schema.

modules_testdata_base_path.description: Base path for nf-test module test data.

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base path for nf-test pipeline test data.
